footer.tagline: A modern self-hosted F-Droid repository. Browse on the web, sync with your F-Droid Android client to install.
footer.pasteHint: Paste this in your F-Droid client to subscribe.

repoCta.title: Subscribe with the F-Droid client.
repoCta.body: Scan the code with your phone, or paste the URL in F-Droid → Settings → Repositories → +.

items.ACCESS_BACKGROUND_LOCATION: access location while in the background
items.MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE: manage all files on the device
items.BODY_SENSORS_BACKGROUND: read body sensors in the background
items.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_LOCATION: run a location service in the foreground
items.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_CAMERA: run a camera service in the foreground
items.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_MICROPHONE: run a microphone service in the foreground
items.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_CONNECTED_DEVICE: run a connected-device service in the foreground
items.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_PHONE_CALL: run a phone-call service in the foreground
items.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_HEALTH: run a health service in the foreground
items.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_REMOTE_MESSAGING: run a remote-messaging service in the foreground
items.SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW: display on top of other apps
items.QUERY_ALL_PACKAGES: list every app installed on the device
items.EXPAND_STATUS_BAR: expand or collapse the status bar
items.KILL_BACKGROUND_PROCESSES: close other apps in the background

home.emptyShelfBody: Once an APK is published you'll see it featured here. Admin: head to <link>My apps → New release</link>.
home.setupAdminCta: An administrator needs to finish the wizard.
home.setupAnonCta: Sign in as an administrator to complete the one-time setup.

tooltip.unknown: Nobody has compared this build against a reference yet.
tooltip.not_attempted: The uploader marked this build as not pursuing reproducibility (e.g. ABI splits, non-deterministic toolchain).
tooltip.verified: The SHA-256 of this APK matches the reference hash recorded for this version.
tooltip.failed: The SHA-256 of this APK does NOT match the recorded reference. Treat any source claims with caution.

appDetail.feedAtomTitle: Subscribe to this app's release feed. Add the URL to your feed reader to get notified on every new version. Private apps require an API key (HTTP Basic auth).

nsfw.title: This app is flagged as adult content.
nsfw.body: <bold>{{name}}</bold> is hidden from the catalogue by default. Confirm you want to see it for this session, or change your preference in <link>account settings</link>.

auth.heroTitle:
Your private app shelf,
on your own server.
auth.heroSubtitle: A modern F-Droid repo with the polish of a real app store.
auth.signupsClosed: Signups are closed. Ask an administrator for an account.

login.title: Welcome back
login.subtitle: Sign in to manage your apps and API keys.
login.inviteLabel: Invite code (only if you don't have an account yet)
login.mfaPrompt: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app, or one of your recovery codes.
login.passkeyIdentifierRequired: Type your email or username first.
login.passkeyMfaBody: Use the passkey registered on this account (Touch ID, Windows Hello, security key…) to finish signing in.
login.enrollmentBody: This account's role is configured to require a passkey. Register one now to continue.

signup.heroTitle:
Open an account.
Ship your apps.
signup.heroSubtitle: Publish your Android releases on your own F-Droid repo. Manage API keys, screenshots, changelogs — all from the same place.
signup.title: Create your account
signup.subtitle: It only takes a moment.
signup.closedSubtitle: Ask an administrator to create an account for you.
signup.inviteRequiredSubtitle: An invite code is required to sign up here.

profile.identitySubtitle: Read-only fields tied to your sign-in provider.
profile.displayNameSubtitle: How your name appears on uploads, comments and reviews.
profile.languageSubtitle: Pick the language the catalogue will use when an app has a matching translation.

password.body: Use a unique password — 8 characters minimum. Changing it does not sign you out elsewhere; use Active sessions for that.

sections.contentSubtitle: Control what shows up on the catalogue and in your F-Droid client.
sections.languageSubtitle: Pick the language the catalogue will use when an app has a matching translation.
sections.apiKeysSubtitle: Use them as the Basic-auth password in your F-Droid client to access private apps.

quotas.body: How much of your repo allowance you've used so far. The ∞ symbol means no cap.

sessions.body: Every active sign-in tied to your account. Revoking one logs that device out at the next refresh.
sessions.revokeAllConfirm: Sign out of every device, including this one?

totp.notEnrolledBody: Add an authenticator app (Aegis, 1Password, …) as a second factor. You'll be asked for a 6-digit code on every sign-in.
totp.setupBody: Scan the QR code with your authenticator app, then enter the 6-digit code it generates to confirm.
totp.recoveryBody: Each code works once and replaces the 6-digit factor. Store them in a password manager — this is the only time we'll show them.
totp.enabledBody: Sign-ins on this account require a 6-digit code from your authenticator (or a recovery code).

passkeys.body: Register a passkey (Touch ID, Windows Hello, YubiKey, your phone…) to sign in without a password and to satisfy the second-factor prompt on this account. Passkeys are phishing-resistant and far stronger than a code.
passkeys.oidcNote: Your account signs in through SSO. Passkeys aren't required, but registering one gives you a passwordless fallback that keeps working if the SSO provider is unreachable.
passkeys.revokeConfirm: Revoke this passkey? Sign-ins relying on it will fail.

nsfwToggle.title: Show NSFW apps
nsfwToggle.body: When off, apps flagged with the F-Droid NSFW anti-feature are hidden from the catalogue, search, and public profiles. Direct links still open behind a confirmation screen. Toggling rebuilds the F-Droid index served to your API keys.

export.title: Export my data
export.body: Download a single JSON file containing everything we keep tied to your account: profile, apps you own (with APK metadata), collaborations, download history, and audit-log entries where you were the actor.

languagePicker.title: Preferred language
languagePicker.body: When an app ships a translation matching your language, you'll see its name, summary and description in that language. Anything else falls back to the publisher's defaults.

apiKey.label: Label
apiKey.canDownloadPrivateBody: Fetch APKs flagged as private, including your own and those of co-maintained projects.
apiKey.canManageAppsBody: Upload, edit and delete apps over the API — equivalent to your own panel rights.
apiKey.newKeyTitle: Add this repo to your F-Droid client now.
apiKey.newKeyBody: Scan the QR with your phone — credentials are embedded so private apps are unlocked automatically. The key won't be shown again.
apiKey.usernameNote: In F-Droid the username can be anything; this one matches your account so revoking it is easier to track.

history.title: Download history
history.subtitle: Every app you've grabbed from this repo, with version comparisons against the latest pressing.
history.heroIntro: Hi {{name}} — you've collected {{apps}} apps and pulled {{downloads}} downloads since {{since}}.
history.updatesSubtitle_one: {{count}} app on your shelf has a newer pressing in the repo
history.updatesSubtitle_other: {{count}} apps on your shelf have newer pressings in the repo
history.emptyHint: Once you sync this repo from your F-Droid client and grab an APK, it lands here with version updates surfaced automatically.
history.whyNoInstalledBody: The F-Droid Android client doesn't broadcast install status to the repository, so we can't truly know if an APK is still on your device. We show the latest version you downloaded plus whether a newer one is available — the closest approximation a server-side view can offer.

stats.title: Stats
stats.subtitlePublic: Aggregate counters for this repo. Private apps are excluded — sign in as an owner to see the full picture.
stats.subtitleAdmin: Admin view — totals include private apps and unpublished APKs.
stats.gatedBody: The admin hasn't enabled the public stats page yet, or the repo itself is in private mode. Sign in to read the figures.
stats.adminOnlyBody: The administrator has restricted /stats to admin accounts. Ask them to flip the visibility on /admin/access if you need a look.

profile.notFoundBody: Either this uploader doesn't exist or they haven't published any public app yet.

myApps.title: My apps
myApps.subtitle: Manage releases, versions and metadata.
myApps.nothingYetBody: Start by uploading your first APK — we extract metadata for you.
myApps.empty: You haven't uploaded any app yet.
myApps.createSubtitle: Drop an APK to bootstrap a listing — package, signer, icon and SDK levels are extracted from the binary.

new.title: New release
new.subtitle: Drop an APK, point at a GitHub repository, or wire an external proxy — we'll pre-fill what we can.
new.step3Subtitle: Optional. Add the bits F-Droid clients surface as buttons on the listing.

proxy.intro: Pick a configured proxy, one of its providers, and paste the upstream URL. fdroid-store probes the proxy, downloads the APK and shows you the metadata before creating the app.
proxy.noProxies: No proxy available. Your admin needs to register one under /admin/proxies before you can use this mode.
proxy.validateFirst: Validate the proxy source before saving.
proxy.oauthFirst: Connect the OAuth account before validating.

new.needIdentity: Title and package name are required.
new.descriptionPlaceholder: What does it do? Highlights, screenshots context, etc.
new.author: Author
new.pickFirst: Step 1: pick an APK to continue.
new.detectedBody: Our scanner spotted these libraries inside the APK. You'll see them again on the app page where you can confirm or dismiss each chip per version.
new.metadataImportBody: Paste an upstream fdroiddata metadata.yml. Empty form fields will be filled in; anything you've already typed is preserved.

github.intro: Provide a owner/name pair from GitHub, GitLab or Gitea/Forgejo. We resolve the latest release, download the matching APK and import its metadata. A daily auto-scan then keeps the app in sync with future releases.
github.baseUrlHint: Leave empty to target the public instance. Provide your self-hosted URL (https://) for private GitLab or Gitea/Forgejo.
github.tokenHint: Required for private repositories. Stored encrypted alongside the source so future scans use the same credential. Empty falls back to the server-side default.
github.validateFirst: Step 1: validate a GitHub repository to continue.
github.patternHint: Glob applied to the release asset name. Leave empty for the first .apk. Examples: *-universal.apk, app-release.apk.
github.includePrereleasesHint: Off — only published, non-prerelease tags are considered. Drafts are always skipped.
github.packageReadOnly: Derived from the parsed APK manifest.

sections.listingSubtitle: Package name is locked to the signing certificate.
sections.graphicsSubtitle: Optional promotional graphics. F-Droid clients pick the right one per surface — feature on phones, TV banner on Android TV, promo as a tablet tile.
sections.iconSubtitle: Auto-extracted from the latest APK. Upload a custom one to lock it.
sections.screenshotsSubtitleReorder: PNG / JPEG / WebP, resized to 1080×1920 max. Drag tiles to reorder.
sections.screenshotsSubtitle: PNG / JPEG / WebP, resized to 1080×1920 max.
sections.translationsSubtitle: Per-locale overrides of the listing fields. F-Droid clients pick the closest match for the user's device locale.
sections.versionsSubtitleAuto: Upload a new APK to publish a new version. The signer must match. The latest published version is auto-suggested to F-Droid clients.
sections.versionsSubtitleManual: Upload a new APK to publish a new version. The signer must match. Suggested version is pinned — uploads no longer auto-bump it.
sections.dangerSubtitle: Deletes the app and all of its versions, icons and screenshots.
sections.collaboratorsSubtitle: Users who can manage this listing alongside you. They get every permission except deleting the app, transferring ownership, changing visibility, and managing this list.
sections.githubSourceSubtitle: Auto-import the latest release of a GitHub repository. A daily scan downloads the matching APK and adds it as a new version — same signer, quota and scan checks apply.
sections.proxySourcesSubtitle: Wire an external proxy (F-Droid mirror, Patreon, kemono.cr, private artefact repo…) to auto-import from a source fdroid-store doesn't scrape natively. Admins deploy the proxies — you pick which proxy and which provider to use.
sections.deployTokensSubtitle: Mint a token your CI can POST APKs to — same signer, quota and scan checks as an interactive upload. Scoped to this app only.

edit.revertIconConfirm: Revert to the icon extracted from the latest APK?

banner.featuredHint: 1024 × 500 — shown above the description on phones.

categories.empty: Nothing selected. Pick one or more below — F-Droid clients use this to group your app in their catalogue.
categories.allSelected: All available categories are already selected.

versions.retentionBody: The oldest APK by versionCode is auto-deleted when this app exceeds the cap. The suggested version is never evicted.
versions.retentionNextEvict: Next upload will delete v{{name}} ({{code}}), the oldest non-suggested version.
versions.retentionOverrideHint: Leave empty to follow the repo-wide default. The per-app cap can only TIGHTEN the default — values higher than the repo default (or ``0`` when a default is set) are clamped back down.
versions.retentionOverrideFailed: Could not save the per-app cap.
versions.suggestThisTitle: Make this the version F-Droid clients recommend

reproducibility.label: Reproducibility
reproducibility.help: Provide a reference SHA-256 and the comparison auto-decides Verified/Failed. Or use "Verify from URL" — the backend fetches the document, extracts hashes (with SSRF guards) and compares against this APK. Every write lands in the audit log.

changelog.title: Release notes for {{version}}
changelog.everyCovered: Every common locale is already covered.
changelog.footnote: Each locale is independent. Empty tabs are dropped on save — they won't ship to the F-Droid client.

translations.description: Override the listing for a specific language. The fields at the top of the page (Title, Summary, Description) ship as your en-US defaults. F-Droid clients show whichever locale matches the device, falling back to the defaults when no override exists.
translations.everyCovered: Every common locale is already on the app.
translations.noTranslations: No translations yet — only your default fields will be served.
translations.badTagBody: Use a BCP47 tag like 'fr-FR' or 'pt-BR'.
translations.nothingToSaveBody: Fill in at least one of Title, Summary, Description or Video URL.

signerLocked.title: Signing certificate locked
signerLocked.body: Subsequent APK uploads must be signed with this exact certificate. Anything else is rejected before it can replace the package.

collaborators.body: Co-maintainers can upload APKs, edit the listing, and manage screenshots / translations. They can't delete the app, change visibility, or manage this list — those stay with you.
collaborators.empty: No co-maintainers yet — only you can manage this app.
collaborators.leaveConfirm: Leave this app? You'll lose management access.

deployTokens.body: Each token is scoped to this app and can only upload new APK versions. Treat it like a password: anyone with the token can publish.
deployTokens.revokeConfirm: Revoke token {{name}}? Any CI still using it will start failing.

reveal.title: Token "{{name}}" minted
reveal.body: Store this token in your CI secrets. Once you close this window, only the prefix is kept on our side — we can't show it again.

instructions.title: Publishing from CI
instructions.body: Send a multipart POST request to the upload endpoint with your deploy token in the Authorization header. The body must contain a single file field carrying the APK.
instructions.tokenNotice: <YOUR_TOKEN> is the token you minted above. We don't store the plaintext — if you lost it, mint a new one.

githubSource.baseUrlHint: Leave empty to target the public instance. Provide your self-hosted URL (https://) for private GitLab or Gitea/Forgejo.
githubSource.tokenHint: Used to inspect + scan private repositories. Stored encrypted.
githubSource.tokenWillBeCleared: Token will be cleared on save
githubSource.repoHint: Paste an owner/name pair or a full https:// clone URL. Private repos need an access token below (or the matching server-side token).
githubSource.patternHint: Glob applied to the release asset name. Leave empty for the first .apk. Examples: *-universal.apk, app-release-*.apk.
githubSource.enabledHint: Off keeps the configuration but pauses the cron. Manual "Scan now" still works.
githubSource.removeConfirm: Disconnect this GitHub source? Imported APKs stay on the app.
githubSource.lostAccess: Lost contact with the backend — refresh to try again.

proposed.title: Want to fill these from the repo?
proposed.body: GitHub gave us values for fields you haven't set yet. Pick the ones you want to keep.

proxySources.intro: Each proxy publishes its own catalogue of providers (F-Droid mirror, Patreon, kemono.cr, private artefact repo, …). One app can hold multiple sources as long as they point at the same package and signer.
proxySources.empty: No proxy source attached. Click "Add a source" to wire one.
proxySources.noProxiesBody: Your admin needs to register a proxy first under /admin/proxies. This section stays empty until they do.
proxySources.createdOk: Proxy source attached. The worker will scan it shortly.
proxySources.removeConfirm: Detach this proxy source? Already-imported APKs stay on the app.
proxySources.scanQueued: Scan queued — the row will refresh automatically.
proxySources.popupBlocked: Browser blocked the OAuth popup. Allow popups for this domain and retry.
proxySources.popupClosed: OAuth popup closed before completion. Retry to finish connecting.

wizard.title: Attach an external source
wizard.proxyHint: Pick one of the proxies your admin has deployed. Each one has its own catalogue of providers.
wizard.providerHint: Providers published by {{proxy}} below. Each provider knows how to scrape a specific source (F-Droid, Patreon, …).
wizard.providerEmpty: This proxy hasn't published a catalogue yet. Ask your admin to click "Test" on /admin/proxies.
wizard.formIntro: Fill in the upstream URL for {{name}}, plus any secrets.
wizard.secretsHint: Secrets are encrypted at rest (Fernet) and only sent to proxy {{proxy}} during a scan.
wizard.oauthConnected: Account connected · ready to attach the source
wizard.oauthBody: A popup opens against {{proxy}}, which completes the OAuth dance and hands us back an opaque credential id. fdroid-store never sees your token — it stays on the proxy.

proxies.title: External sources (proxies)
proxies.subtitle: fdroid-store delegates non-native sources (Patreon, kemono, F-Droid, a private artefact registry, …) to external proxy services speaking the v1 protocol. Each proxy declares its own providers and auth modes — fdroid-store stays neutral, the operator picks what to plug in.
proxies.addHint: Deploy the proxy separately (the reference F-Droid proxy ships in the compose stack under the ``proxy-fdroid`` profile), then paste its URL and the shared secret here.

fields.name: Name
fields.authTokenHint: Must match the env var on the proxy side. Fernet-encrypted at rest.

proxies.empty: No proxy registered. Add one to plug external sources (F-Droid, Patreon, …) into the apps on this repo.
proxies.noProviders: No provider exposed yet — refresh the proxy or check its config.
proxies.confirmDelete: Delete proxy "{{name}}"? Every app source attached to it will be removed too.

backup.title: Backup & restore
backup.subtitle: Heavy work runs on the arq worker — the request returns immediately with a job id and the progress streams back to this page (and to the Jobs page).

components.label: What to include
components.restoreHint: Only items present in the backup are applied — unchecked items are skipped even if present.

db.title: Database
db.body: Users, apps, APK metadata, audit log, sessions — every row in the public schema.

keystore.title: Signing key
keystore.body: The PKCS#12 keystore used to sign the F-Droid index. Restoring this changes the repo's fingerprint.

assets.title: Assets
assets.body: App icons + screenshots. Light, visually critical for the catalogue.

apks.title: APKs & index
apks.body: The APK binaries themselves plus the generated F-Droid index files. The bulk of the storage footprint.

create.title: Create a backup
create.body: The worker runs pg_dump + tars the storage tree + bundles the signing keystore, then encrypts the whole thing with AES-256-GCM (scrypt KDF). The .env (database password, signing-key password, OIDC secret) is NOT included — those stay where you put them.
create.passphraseShort: Passphrase must be at least 12 characters
create.warn: Save the passphrase outside this backup — without it the file is unrecoverable. We don't store it server-side beyond the run.

restore.title: Restore from a backup
restore.dangerBody: Restoring wipes every table in the public schema, then replays the dump. The storage tree is replaced wholesale. Active sessions get terminated mid-request; users will need to sign back in. There's no undo and restores cannot be cancelled once the wipe has started.
restore.confirmRequired: Type RESTORE in the confirmation field
restore.lastChance: Are you absolutely sure? This will wipe the current database and storage. There is no undo.

history.title: Recent jobs
history.empty: No backup or restore jobs yet.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.subtitle: Append-only timeline of admin and user actions: deletions, role changes, repo config updates, malware scans.
audit.empty: Nothing recorded yet — every consequential action lands here.
audit.emptyFilter: No events match the current filters.

jobs.title: Job control
jobs.subtitle: Live view of the Redis-backed worker queue. Auto-polls every 10 seconds; pause to inspect a specific run.
jobs.autoRefreshTitle: Toggles the page's 10-second auto-poll. Does not pause the worker — use it when you want to inspect a row without the list reshuffling.
jobs.unavailable: Could not reach the job queue.

scanning.title: Scanning
scanning.subtitle: Two optional scanners hook into the upload pipeline: ClamAV for malware detection and Trivy for SBOM + CVE extraction. Each runs in its own service (start with the matching compose profile), the worker dispatches the work, and results land below.
scanning.malwareBody: On-upload + periodic scans of every published APK via the optional clamd service.

cve.title: CVE / SBOM scanning (Trivy)
cve.body: Per-APK SBOM extraction (CycloneDX) + vulnerability lookup via the optional Trivy server. Results are visible to owners, collaborators and admins only — never on the public catalogue.
cve.envHint: Set TRIVY_SERVER_URL in .env (e.g. ``TRIVY_SERVER_URL=http://trivy:4954``) and bring the stack up with ``docker compose --profile trivy up -d`` to start the bundled server. The server must be reachable from the worker.
cve.toggleBody: Every newly attached APK is queued for a CVE scan. Manual re-scans are also available from each APK's row in /my-apps.

rb.title: Reproducible Builds verification
rb.body: Lets maintainers record that an APK has been reproduced independently (typically against verification.f-droid.org or a CI build). History stays in the database when the feature is disabled — the badge on the app page and the per-APK editor in /my-apps are just hidden.
rb.toggleBody: When off, POST /reproducibility endpoints return 403 and the matching UI disappears. Historical data is preserved.

scans.title: Malware scans
scans.subtitle: Optional ClamAV scanning of every published APK. Enable in the toggles below; scans are recorded here whether they hit or not.
scans.envHint: Set CLAMAV_HOST in .env (e.g. ``CLAMAV_HOST=clamav``) and bring the stack up with ``docker compose --profile clamav up -d`` to start the bundled scanner. The clamd server must be reachable from both backend and worker.
scans.toggleUploadBody: Every uploaded APK is scanned synchronously. Infected uploads are refused with a 422.
scans.togglePeriodicBody: The worker re-scans every published APK once a day at 03:00 UTC — catches signature updates after the fact.
scans.scanNowBody: Runs the same job as the daily cron, but bypasses the toggle and the 24h cutoff. Useful to validate the setup or check after a signature update.
scans.scanNowDisabledReason: ClamAV is unreachable — start the scanner container before running a manual scan.

overview.title: Dashboard
overview.subtitle: A quick read of what's in the repo and recent activity.

apps.title: Apps & APKs
apps.subtitle: Moderate listings, approve pressings, and keep the catalogue tidy.
apps.search: Search by name, package or author…
apps.rejectPlaceholder: e.g. signature mismatch, missing privacy policy…

drawer.lifecycleBody: Switch the public visibility status of this app. Publishing surfaces it in the catalogue; archive hides it without deleting.
drawer.versionsBody: Every APK ever uploaded to this app. Pending ones can be published or rejected with a reason.
drawer.signatureUnset: Will be locked the first time an APK is published.

apps.empty: No apps yet. Have someone upload one!
apps.emptyFilter: No apps match the current filter.

categories.title: Categories
categories.subtitle: The taxonomy used to group apps in the catalogue and in F-Droid clients. Renaming a category propagates everywhere; deleting one simply un-tags the apps that referenced it.
categories.addDescriptionPlaceholder: One-line hint for users browsing this group.
categories.cleanupConfirm_one: Delete the {{count}} empty category? This cannot be undone.
categories.cleanupConfirm_other: Delete the {{count}} empty categories? This cannot be undone.
categories.deleteHintEmpty: This category has no apps tagged.
categories.deleteConfirmWithApps: "{{name}}" is currently used by {{count}} app(s). Deleting it will un-tag those apps. Continue?
categories.empty: No categories yet. Add one above to get started.
categories.noEmpty: Nothing to clean up — every category has at least one app.

users.title: Users
users.subtitle: Manage who can sign in and what they can do.
users.emptyUsers: No accounts yet — invite your first user.
users.emptyFilter: No accounts match the current filter.
users.passwordTooShort: Password must be at least 8 characters.

drawer.accountActiveBody: The user can sign in and use the API.
drawer.accountDisabledBody: Sign-in blocked. Existing tokens are revoked.
drawer.roleAdminBody: Full access to every app, user, and repo setting.
drawer.roleUploaderBody: Can publish and manage their own apps. No admin UI.
drawer.roleUserBody: Browse and download only. No /my-apps access.
drawer.resetPasswordBody: Mint a new password and hand it to the user. Their sessions are revoked on save.
drawer.resetPasswordWarn: Existing tokens for this user will be invalidated as soon as you save.
drawer.dangerBody: Permanently delete {{username}}'s account, API keys, sessions, and downloads history. Their apps stay published unless you remove them first.
drawer.dangerLastAdmin: This is the last active admin — disable or demote someone else first.
drawer.inviteBody: Create the account, hand the password to the user.
drawer.inviteCopyHint: Copy the password before closing — we won't show it again.

users.quotaBody: Empty = follow the repo-wide default. Storage cap is in mebibytes.

access.title: Access & registration
access.subtitle: Choose who can browse the catalogue, sync the F-Droid index, and create new accounts. Changes apply instantly.
access.publicModeBody: When public, anyone can browse public apps on the website and any F-Droid client can sync the public repo without credentials. Private apps are still gated by API keys, regardless of this setting.
access.privateOptionSubtitle: Login or API key required everywhere
access.registrationBody: Controls who can create an account. OIDC follows the same rule — existing users always log in, but a new SSO account needs the same permission as a local signup.
access.uploadLimitsBody: Hard cap on APK uploads. Larger files are refused before they hit disk. Set this just above your largest legitimate release.
access.publicStatsBody: Aggregate stats page at /stats (totals, top apps, downloads-per-day, category breakdown). Private apps are always excluded from the public view.
access.publicStatsOffSubtitle: Stats restricted to administrators. Plain users get 403.
access.publicStatsOnSubtitle: Visible to everyone. Anonymous fallback follows the catalogue's public-mode toggle.
access.publicStatsNoteWhenPrivate: Note: the repo is in private mode, so anonymous callers still need to sign in to read /stats even with the page set to public.
access.passkeyPolicyBody: Force the listed roles to register a WebAuthn passkey. Accounts without one are routed to a forced-enrolment screen after their next password step.
access.passkeyPolicyOidcNote: This policy doesn't apply to SSO/OIDC sessions — the identity provider handles the second factor. OIDC users can still optionally register a passkey for a passwordless fallback.
access.passkeyAdminOffSubtitle: Passkeys are available but admins can still log in without one.
access.passkeyAdminOnSubtitle: Every admin must enrol a passkey at next sign-in.
access.passkeyUploaderOffSubtitle: Passkeys are available but uploaders can still log in without one.
access.passkeyUploaderOnSubtitle: Every uploader must enrol a passkey at next sign-in.
access.apkSizeError: APK size cap must be between 5 and 2000 MB
access.invitesBody: Single-use codes. Share each one with the person you're inviting; it burns out after their first successful signup.
access.newCode: New invite code — copy it now

repo.title: Repository
repo.publicAddressHint: Must be reachable from Android devices.
repo.mirrorsBody: Alternate URLs that serve the same repo. F-Droid clients fall back to a mirror if the primary address is unreachable. Save to apply.
repo.noKeystore: No keystore yet — complete the setup wizard.
repo.quotasBody: Caps applied to every user that doesn't have a per-user override. Leave empty for no cap (∞). Storage is in mebibytes.
repo.maxVersionsHint: When an app has more than N APK rows, the oldest by versionCode is auto-deleted on the next upload. The suggested version is never evicted. Leave empty for no cap.

setup.title: Setup wizard
setup.subtitleComplete: Setup is complete. Re-run to rotate the signing key.
setup.subtitleIncomplete: Finish the one-time configuration to start serving the catalogue.
setup.complete: Setup complete. The repo index will be generated on the next reindex.

antiFeatures.title: Anti-features
antiFeatures.subtitle: Flag this version with anti-feature labels.
